title: feat(app-shell): the Interfaces canvas gets its 设计⇄运行 switch; the app teleport retires (#5800)
body:
Closes #5800 (cloud#1609 增量二, the last increment).

- **One canvas, two modes**: the switch flips `editing` — design keeps selection/inspector/overlays; run is pure subtraction and the SAME renderer serves the interactive runtime (dashboard overlays gone, 新建/录入 live). Selection survives the round trip. Pinned through the dashboard leaf, whose `widget-click-overlay` IS the mode.
- **打开应用 teleport retired** — run mode is the in-workbench way to try the app; 创建应用 + pending badge stay. (No test referenced the button; i18n keys left in place.)
- **顺手修** the /access app-detection drift found in the live walkthrough: published-only read → now the pillar's draft-fallback resolution, re-resolved on draft saves + the metadata-refresh pulse, so pillar deep-links can't disagree about whether the app exists.

35 files / 197 tests green; 0 eslint errors. Staging-only train per the release directive.
